message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts the cover of Tempo magazine, dated "EDISI 11-17 MARET 2013". The top third of the cover features the large red word "TEMPO" against a white background. Above this, text reads "PEDAGANG BAYI DI SEKITAR KITA" and "ANGGARAN PEMERINTAH UNTUK DAKWAH PKS".

The center contains four vertical rectangular panels, each showing a painted portrait of a man’s face and shoulders. From left to right: a man with short black hair wearing a white shirt and dark jacket; a man with black hair, glasses, a mustache, a white shirt, a black bow tie, and a dark suit jacket; a man with dark hair and a beard wearing a black turtleneck; and a man with black hair wearing a yellow collared shirt and a dark vest. All four men are smiling.

Below the portraits, black text lists names: "AZIZ SYAMSUDDIN", "HERMAN HERRY", "NAZARUDDIN", and "BAMBANG SOESATYO". Underneath, large red text reads "TERSERET SIMULATOR", followed by smaller black text: "DJOKO SUSILO DIDUGA MENGGELONTORKAN RP 10 MILIAR AGAR DPR MELOLOSKAN ANGGARAN PROYEK BERMASALAH." A barcode and "RP 33.000" are at the bottom left.
